transcript.content: Hello. I'm Dr. Smith. To get us started, could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I... I guess I'm here because I've been having these thoughts. Just... thinking it would be better if I didn't wake up. Like, maybe dying would just be... fair. A fair punishment for what I've done to my family, and the guys I work with.
Have you ever felt this way or experienced these symptoms at any point in your life before this current period?
No. I... I don't think so. Not like this.
You mentioned feeling like you've done something to your family and coworkers; did these current feelings begin specifically after a particular event or change in your life?
I suppose... yeah. It's been going on for about... a year and five months. My husband had a back injury. He's mostly housebound now because of it, so... I guess it started since then.
Besides the feelings of sadness and hopelessness you described, have you also been feeling unusually anxious, nervous, or worried since this started?
I don't think so. I haven't really been... nervous. Just... what I said before.
How have these feelings affected your ability to handle your daily responsibilities at work or at home?

I... I had to stop leading the flooring jobs at work. I just couldn't do it safely anymore. I couldn't manage the crew or the clients... or figure out the right decisions. 

My apprentice... and my husband, they kind of started stepping in for me. Just... before I ruined the work, I guess. Or put someone at risk. So I don't do that part anymore.
Since this started over a year ago, have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or your weight?
I guess... yeah. Most days I just... forget to eat until it's late. Or I'll take a few bites and just feel sick. I'm not trying to lose weight or anything, but... my work pants are loose now.
Over the past seventeen months, have there been any stretches of time where you felt completely like your old self, without these feelings of sadness and hopelessness?

No... not really. I mean, some weeks aren't as heavy, I guess. But... the guilt, the feeling tired all the time... just not caring about anything... it's mostly always there. And the thoughts about... you know, death. It just doesn't really go away.
Over these past seventeen months, have you been having any trouble with your sleep, such as difficulty falling asleep, staying asleep, or sleeping too much?
No... I don't think so. I sleep okay, I guess. I haven't really noticed any problems with it.
Do you often feel like you aren't good enough or that you have a low opinion of yourself?

Yeah... I guess I do. It's just... I keep thinking about how I ruined things. My husband... he got worse, and I think it's my fault. And the crew at work... they lost jobs because of me. I just... I messed up clients' floors, their homes. It feels like... like I just poison everything I touch. I deserve... whatever bad things happen to me now.
During these past seventeen months, have you felt like you have much less energy or motivation to do things than you used to, even for tasks that you would normally find easy or enjoyable?

Yeah... I guess so. It just... it doesn't take much anymore. By the time I carry just one box of tile... or try to answer a couple client messages... my body just feels like wet cement. And my head... it gets so tired I can't even make simple decisions. So... yeah. I don't have much energy.
During these past seventeen months, have there ever been two weeks in a row where you felt so low that you couldn't function at all, even more so than how you've been feeling generally?
No... I don't think so. It's just... been the same, mostly. Just... heavy. Every day.
Do you find that you have a hard time focusing on things or making decisions, even for simple, everyday tasks?
I don't know... maybe. I guess it's hard to tell. I just... I don't really pay attention to that.
